label: preparing
what: Likely a service-acknowledgement gathering in the great hall at day 1, 18:00, with community-supper hospitality, initially presented to the mayor as a routine lighting inspection. Builder coordinates the hall and escort; neighbour solicits food and agrees to escort the mayor; innkeeper is named as hospitality coordinator. Freight is named as donation receiver and baker assists route coordination. The exact honouree, full programme, and whether baker and freight knew the acknowledgement's concealed purpose are not established. Secretary only demonstrably handles the openly approved appointment, not the concealed preparation.
